bodies.scope: Outcome settlement account projection skips two reserved token addresses, requires each looked-up available balance to equal total, checks each coarse-weight product for u64 overflow, and emits nonzero leg totals followed by a nonzero summed payout. Missing balances are zero; the second product follows the first balance/product checks. Sum overflow calls a diagnostic and saturates if it returns. Lookup internals, diagnostic effects, parallel scheduling, token units, full payout validation and application to balances remain outside the claim.
